attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Missouri corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Missouri Corporate Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto false result.mo_has_nexus xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts); result.mo_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.mo_economic_nexus_threshold

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no filing required false result.mo_has_nexus xdef 0.0 result.mo_tax_liability xdef "Missouri filing not required: No nexus with state" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Missouri state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. UNIQUE FEATURE: Missouri allows deduction of 50% of federal income tax paid.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Missouri Corporate Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mo_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mo_state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Missouri state additions and subtractions (including 50% federal tax deduction); Calculate state-specific income adjustments

action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 result.mo_state_additions xdef 0.0 result.mo_state_subtractions xdef "Missouri adjustments not calculated: No nexus" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Missouri corporate income tax. Applies Missouri flat rate (4.0%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. The 50% federal tax deduction significantly reduces effective tax burden.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Missouri Corporate Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 result.mo_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mo_tax_liability xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.mo_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Missouri corporate tax (flat rate 4.0%); Apply Missouri 4.0% flat rate
No taxable income - no tax liability

action_details.action_postfix: // No nexus - no tax liability 0.0 result.mo_taxable_income xdef 0.0 result.mo_tax_liability xdef result.mo_estimated_payments result.mo_refund_or_owed xdef "Missouri tax liability: $0 (no nexus)" job.audit_trail swap addto
